Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for early March 2023

Body.Content:
In early March 2023, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Compute percentiles for a large dataset more quickly by using approximate percentile in Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
